note: Improvement suggestions for the site and for decision-making. Suggestions are project-design proposals, not verified external facts. Each carries the official source or methodology reference it relies on, or is explicitly labeled project design. Status starts at 'proposed' so a reviewer can choose the best path before implementation.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a visible data-freshness indicator and a freshness gate to every data-backed page: show the snapshot date vs today, and block strategy promotion when the snapshot exceeds a defined age (e.g., 7 days) or when a required source is stale.
suggestions.why: The canonical snapshot (2026-11-04) is now two weeks old and Week 9 is complete (RV-01). A freshness gate prevents 'current' labels from overstating freshness and makes staleness a hard, visible decision input.
suggestions.files_scope: root pages/generator + analysis gates (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Define the age threshold; link each freshness check to the official source's last-captured date.

suggestions.suggestion: Populate the officially-published injury type and game status instead of leaving those cells blank, and add a per-game availability completeness score (fields captured / fields available on the official page).
suggestions.why: The official Week 9 report publishes injury types and game statuses that the canonical injuries page currently blanks (RV-03). Filling verified fields strengthens the availability gate (G4) without adding unverified values.
suggestions.files_scope: root injuries data + generator (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Re-transcribe from the official injury page; blank any field the official page does not publish.

suggestions.suggestion: Expand injury capture from the two model-evaluated games to the full slate each week, and schedule an automated weekly fetch of the official injury report.
suggestions.why: Only JAX/BAL of 14 Week 9 games were transcribed (RV-04, F-22). Full-slate capture makes per-game availability gates computable across the board.
suggestions.files_scope: root injuries data + capture pipeline (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Capture all games for a week; verify each row against the official page before publication.

suggestions.suggestion: Build a lineup-impact signal module that tracks, for offense and defense, which string (starter / 2nd / 3rd / 4th) is playing at each position, sourced from official injury reports plus official rosters/depth charts.
suggestions.why: The project goal requires knowing deficiencies when backups replace starters on offense and defense. The Week 9 report already yields a concrete verified case: BAL starter QB Lamar Jackson (Out) and backup Tyler Huntley (Out) leave 3rd-string QB Joe Fagnano (Full Participation) as the likely starter.
suggestions.files_scope: new signal module (integration-owned namespace); this workspace documents the proposal and the verified example
suggestions.verification_required: Resolve the starter/backup 'string' from an official roster/depth-chart source; leave unresolved strings blank and flagged.

suggestions.suggestion: Add an evidence-completeness score per strategy (count of required gates PASS / total required) shown next to each strategy, so a reviewer can see exactly what is missing before any decision.
suggestions.why: Decision-making is blocked by gates, not by a single number. A per-strategy completeness score makes the decision input explicit and reviewable.
suggestions.files_scope: root leaderboard/gates generator (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Score must be derived from the committed gate statuses; no inferred PASS.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a correlation matrix with confidence intervals and a multiplicity adjustment (e.g., Holm), clearly separating team-aggregate descriptive correlations, game-level correlations, and bet-leg dependence.
suggestions.why: Bet-leg correlation values are currently blank (UNVERIFIED). A structured matrix with CIs and multiplicity control makes the correlation library a real decision input and prevents over-reading descriptive aggregates as betting dependence.
suggestions.files_scope: root correlations generator (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Each value recomputed from official data; CI and adjustment method stated; unverified pairs stay blank.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a skill-vs-luck decomposition (variance partition / intraclass correlation with bootstrap confidence intervals and permutation tests) that reports the share of outcome variance attributable to skill vs luck, with an explicit statement that luck cannot be eliminated.
suggestions.why: The goal is to remove luck and build selectively skill-based strategies. A reported, uncertainty-aware luck share is the honest version of that goal and prevents an unsupported 'luck-free' claim.
suggestions.files_scope: root analysis (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Recompute from official game data; report CIs; do not certify skill-only.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a pre-registered, immutable paper-tournament settlement ledger with exposure caps and drawdown stress tests; award paper points only after all applicable gates PASS.
suggestions.why: The leaderboard currently has no settled ledger and no rewards. A pre-registered settlement ledger is the prerequisite for a fair, skill-rewarding competition.
suggestions.files_scope: root leaderboard generator (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Settlement rules pre-registered before grading; no reward before gates PASS.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a review workflow to this suggestions section so each suggestion has a status (proposed / accepted / in progress / done / rejected) and a named reviewer, so a reviewer can choose the best path before implementation.
suggestions.why: The user asked for a dedicated suggestions section where someone can review suggestions and choose the best path before changes. This workspace is that section; a status workflow makes it usable.
suggestions.verification_required: Status changes recorded in COORDINATION.md with the reviewer and rationale.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a per-strategy decision-gate checklist that maps each strategy to its gate outcomes and the specific missing evidence blocking promotion.
suggestions.why: Ties strategy promotion to explicit, reviewable gates and makes the decision path transparent.
suggestions.files_scope: root validation-gates generator (integration-owned); this workspace documents the proposal
suggestions.verification_required: Checklist derived from committed gate statuses only.
